mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE slot_numbers AS ( SELECT 1 AS slot_no UNION ALL SELECT slot_no + 1 FROM slot_numbers WHERE slot_no < 20 ), attendance AS ( SELECT emp_id, MAX(emp_name) AS emp_name, MAX(emp_team) AS emp_team, SUM(COALESCE(finish_data, 0)) AS completed_count FROM fqc_attendance_record WHERE record_date = #{statDate} AND is_deleted = 0 AND emp_team IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND (#{empName} IS NULL OR emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{empName}, '%')) AND (#{empTeam} IS NULL OR emp_team = #{empTeam}) GROUP BY emp_id ), task_slots AS ( SELECT et.emp_id, et.emp_name, et.emp_team, TRIM(ELT( slot_numbers.slot_no, et.sn_code1, et.sn_code2, et.sn_code3, et.sn_code4, et.sn_code5, et.sn_code6, et.sn_code7, et.sn_code8, et.sn_code9, et.sn_code10, et.sn_code11, et.sn_code12, et.sn_code13, et.sn_code14, et.sn_code15, et.sn_code16, et.sn_code17, et.sn_code18, et.sn_code19, et.sn_code20 )) AS sn_code FROM fqc_employee_task et CROSS JOIN slot_numbers WHERE et.task_date = #{statDate} AND et.task_type = 2 AND et.is_deleted = 0 AND et.emp_team IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND (#{empName} IS NULL OR et.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{empName}, '%')) AND (#{empTeam} IS NULL OR et.emp_team = #{empTeam}) ), task_sns AS ( SELECT emp_id, emp_name, emp_team, sn_code FROM task_slots WHERE sn_code IS NOT NULL AND sn_code != '' ), task_stats AS ( SELECT ts.emp_id, MAX(ts.emp_name) AS emp_name, MAX(ts.emp_team) AS emp_team, COUNT(*) AS assigned_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.sn_code IS NULL OR sc.function_endtime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete_count FROM task_sns ts LEFT JOIN fqc_switch_cabinet sc ON sc.sn_code = ts.sn_code AND sc.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ts.emp_id ), employee_base AS ( SELECT emp_id FROM attendance UNION SELECT emp_id FROM task_stats ) SELECT base.emp_id AS empId, COALESCE(tasks.emp_name, attendance.emp_name) AS empName, COALESCE(tasks.emp_team, attendance.emp_team) AS empTeam, COALESCE(tasks.assigned_count, 0) AS assignedCount, COALESCE(attendance.completed_count, 0) AS completedCount, COALESCE(tasks.incomplete_count, 0) AS incompleteCount FROM employee_base base LEFT JOIN attendance ON attendance.emp_id = base.emp_id LEFT JOIN task_stats tasks ON tasks.emp_id = base.emp_id ORDER BY base.emp_id
